app.title: Clipboard
toast.hotkey_taken: ⌘⇧Z already in use — is CopyQ still running?
toast.not_trusted: Copied. To paste automatically, allow CopyQ-rs in System Settings → Accessibility
toast.marked_password: Marked as password: encrypted and hidden
toast.login_needs_approval: Approve in System Settings → General → Login Items
row.unmark_password: Not a password: show in plain text (⌘L)
row.mark_password: This is a password: encrypt and hide (⌘L)
row.hidden_password_tip: Hidden password — click or ↵ to copy it
empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.subtitle: Copy some text with ⌘C and it will show up here.
settings.title: Settings
limits.oldest_deleted: Beyond this, the oldest are deleted.
limits.images_help: Counted in the total; 0 = no images kept.
general.auto_paste_help: The chosen item is pasted straight into the app you opened the history from (⌘⇧Z).
general.hide_after_copy_help: The window closes as soon as an item is chosen; then press ⌘V.
general.save_images_help: Screenshots and copied images, encrypted on disk with the keychain key (number set in Limits). Files copied in the Finder (videos, sounds, PDFs…) are always kept, by their location.
general.open_at_login_help: Launches CopyQ-rs when you log in.
general.open_at_login_unavailable: Available once the app is installed as an application (.app).
general.save_passwords_help: Copies marked confidential by 1Password, Bitwarden, the keychain… Encrypted on disk with a key kept in the macOS keychain, shown hidden and excluded from search.
general.detect_passwords_help: For browser extensions (Dashlane, 1Password, Bitwarden…) that don't flag their copies: a text with no spaces, 8 to 128 characters, mixing upper case, lower case and digits. ⌘L fixes a mistake on an item.
general.keychain_error: ⚠ Keychain unavailable ({error}): passwords stay in memory without being saved, and images are not kept.
error.files_missing: file(s) not found — moved or deleted?
error.files_write: could not put the files on the clipboard
error.login_unavailable: open at login is unavailable on this version of macOS
